name: LCORL / NCAPG (height)
summary: LCORL / NCAPG on chromosome 3, the best-established major locus for height at the withers and overall body size. Each L copy makes the horse taller than like-bred horses without it, roughly additively. The marker laboratories test (BIEC2-808543, near LCORL) is reported as T for the smaller allele and C for the taller, or as n and H1; L here is the taller allele. It shifts the expected height within a breed and does not set a height: a horse with no L copy is not thereby a pony. No direct effect on speed, muscle, jumping or any coat trait is established.

phenotypes.name: Tall
phenotypes.description: Two tall copies. The strongest tendency toward a taller, larger frame.

phenotypes.name: Part tall
phenotypes.description: One tall copy. Intermediate in height between the two homozygotes - the alleles roughly add.

phenotypes.name: Wild type
phenotypes.description: No tall copy. Smaller or average height for the breed.

citations.label: Metzger et al. 2013, expression levels of LCORL are associated with body size in horses (PLoS ONE)
